name: Lost Tales of Altoris
detailed_description:
Step into the forgotten world of Vokir Island, where echoes of a lost past stir within the mists.
You are the Lost Guardian, awakening with fragmented memories and an unshakable pull toward an uncertain destiny.
As darkness tightens its grip over the land, specters of your former life rise to meet you — foes, allies, and secrets long buried beneath the sands of time.

Lost Tales of Altoris invites you into a dark fantasy open world RPG experience where story, exploration, and combat are deeply intertwined.
Crafted across 16 square kilometers of detailed, living terrain, Vokir Island offers not only breathtaking realism, but hidden truths awaiting discovery. From its ruined villages to its mist-laden forests, the world itself feels alive — and it remembers you.

The journey unfolds across six gripping chapters, each offering around 10 hours of immersive gameplay. Your path through the island will be defined not by levels or numbers, but by the choices you make, the bonds you forge, and the battles you survive.
In Lost Tales of Altoris, there is no traditional leveling system — your strength is shaped organically by your actions, decisions, and the memories you reclaim.

Combat is visceral, dynamic, and unforgiving. Every strike, every dodge, and every clash of steel is grounded in realism, rewarding players who adapt, think, and fight with precision.

You are not a blank slate — you are a soul with a history, a designated character intertwined with the fate of the island.
As you journey through the rising storm, your awakening will determine not just your future, but the fate of Vokir itself.

Will you rise to become the island’s lost savior — or fall to the shadows that once claimed you?

Gameplay Features

  • 16 sq. km open world

  • Visceral punishing combat with dynamic responses

  • Challenging traversal puzzles

  • Mysterious lore-based puzzles

  • Dangerous traps

  • A main story rich with lore spanning 10 hours of gameplay

  • A unique soundtrack to drive home the intense feelings and themes

  • Storage: 30 GB available space

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
